# AgentOps Monitor (agentopsmonitor.com)
> Production-grade observability, telemetry, and security monitoring for multi-agent AI systems, LLM pipelines, and autonomous workflows.

AgentOps Monitor provides real-time telemetry, OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing, cost and token tracking, security policy guardrails, and anomaly alerts for autonomous AI agent networks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Agent Distributed Tracing**: Track parent-child agent workflows, tool execution trees, and task dependencies with sub-millisecond trace ingestion.
- **Cost & Token Intelligence**: Granular per-session, per-model, and per-tool cost analytics with proactive budget exhaustion and runaway loop circuit breakers.
- **Security & Threat Detection**: Detect prompt injection, data exfiltration, loop runaway states, and unapproved tool access with automated killswitches.
- **Framework & SDK Support**: Native integration with LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Swarm, and standard OpenTelemetry OTLP collectors.

## Quick Start (plain HTTPS ingestion)
Ingestion is a single authenticated HTTPS endpoint. Create an API key (prefix `aom_live_`) under Account -> API keys, then POST a JSON trace:
- Python: `requests.post("https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer aom_live_..."}, json={...})`
- Any other stack: send the same JSON body with the same `Authorization: Bearer aom_live_...` header.

Trace schema and error codes: see [Documentation & Integration Guides](https://agentopsmonitor.com/docs).
